violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION AND THAT MORE STAFF RECEIVE A CERTIFICATION. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED BOWLS STORED IN BULK FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE ON PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE. PLEASE ENSURE UTENSILS WITH HANDLES ARE KEPT IN BULK FOOD ITEMS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crates found used for the following purpose: ELEVATE DRY STORAGE ITEMS OFF THE GROUND.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. PLEASE ENSURE MILK CRATES ARE REPLACED WITH SHELVING AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment is not resistant to corrosion: OBSERVED NON-NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS (NON-FOOD GRADE) USED TO STORE BULK DRY-FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. PLEASE ENSURE THESE CONTAINERS ARE GRADUALLY REPLACED WITH NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH A CONTAINER AT THE HAND WASH SINK NEAR THE MICROWAVE; OBSERVED A CONTAINER IN THE BACK HAND WASH SINK NEAR THE DISHWASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF UNDERSTAND HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD BE UED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED SOME FOOD ITEMS WITHOUT A DATE MARKING IN THE WALK-IN COOLER THAT WERE MADE MORE THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE AND WILL EMAIL PIC A COPY OF A DATE MARKING INFORMATION SHEET. FOOD ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION WILL BE DISCARDED OF BY THE END OF THE DAY. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF ARE TRAINED ON PROPER DATE MARKING SYSTEM AND A CONSISTENT SYSTEM IS PUT INTO PLACE.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: GARLIC PEEL manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE DISCONTINUE REUSING THESE CONTAINERS AS THEY ARE NOT NSF APPROVED AND ARE NOT MADE TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: OBSERVED NON-NSF APPROVED BUCKETS USED FOR FOOD PREPARATION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. PLEASE ONLY USE NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS FOR FOOD STORAGE AND PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS AND WALLS AT THE COOKLINE are need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE AREAS SHOULD BE THOROUGHLY CLEANED ON A MORE FREQUENT BASIS TO PREVENT FOOD GRIME/DERBIS ACCUMULATION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SMALL CONTAINERS OF RICE PORTIONED AT 129-133F AND MADE APPROXIMATELY AN HOUR PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. DUE TO TIME, RICE WAS SERVED TO PATRONS BY END OF INSPECTION. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER HOT HOLDING PRACTICES WITH THE STAFF AND ALSO DISCUSSED OPTION OF USING TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL. PLEASE ENSURE HOT FOODS ARE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and food stored less than 6 inches off the floor IN THE WALK-IN COOLER AND IN THE DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOOD ITEMS SHOULD BE ELEVATED OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: OBSERVED KIMCHI DATED 3/14/25 AND PICKLED CABBAGE WITHOUT A DATE MARKING, BUT PIC CONFIRMED WAS MADE OVER 10 DAYS PRIOR TO INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS TCS FOODS MAY NOT BE KEPT FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS (INCLUDING DAY OF PREPARATION).
